system.description:
This jutsu can only be cast as a Taijutsu Finisher targeting an airborne or falling creature.

As a part of casting this jutsu, you must be gaining the benefits of at least the 5th Gate: Limit or higher, from the 8-Inner Gates: Seimon Taijutsu feat.

Once this jutsu is cast, you cannot cast it again until you spend at least 10 minutes recovering from the strain it places on your body.

You leap into the air in a distinctive stance and begin punching the enemy repeatedly, so quickly in fact that they are set ablaze by the sheer speed and friction which in turn, creates a peacock-like fan of flames around the target.

Make a number of melee taijutsu attacks equal to your proficiency bonus dealing 1d6 damage on the first hit, then each successful hit after the first, increase damage die by +1. You cannot add your ability modifier to the damage dealt.

If you Score at least 5 hits this way, at the conclusion of this jutsu, the target is slammed back into the ground and have to make a Constitution saving throw, being Stunned until the end of their next turn on a failed save.

activities.label: Finisher: Asakujaku
activities.text: Finisher only, an airborne or falling target; 5th Gate or higher; once per 10 minutes of rest. Attacks equal to your proficiency bonus, no ability modifier; each hit after the first deals one more die (1d6, 2d6, 3d6...).

roll.note: For the nth hit, change the dice count to n by hand.

activities.label: Finisher: Stunned (5+ hits)
activities.text: Five or more hits. Failure: Stunned until the end of its next turn.
